patterns: APPSC asks single facts with an AP tilt: Chadalawada Gokul Gram district (Nellore), Chintaladeevi = National Kamadhenu Breeding Centre, AP as 'Aqua hub', inland fisheries definition.
World-rank statements recur: India largest milk producer, 2nd in fruits/vegetables/sugar; 'biggest producer of vegetables' is the trap.
Silk: Muga endemic to Assam; Karnataka largest (mulberry) silk state; AP + Karnataka produce most raw silk.
Other PSCs heavily ask institute locations (NDRI Karnal, NDDB Anand, CFTRI Mysore) and Blue Revolution = pisciculture.
App MCQs lean on Economic Survey numbers (362.08 MT, 33% GVA, 8.8% growth) that PYQs do not test at that depth.
